observations: Three photos show a large, dirty, metallic automotive gearbox lying on a dirt ground.
The gearbox has a cylindrical housing with visible bolts, a yellow sticker or mark on the top, and various hoses, wires, and connectors attached.
The unit appears to be a transmission or gearbox assembly, likely from a heavy-duty vehicle.
The surrounding area is cluttered with other parts, a blue plastic crate, and a tarp-covered object.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on the gearbox in any photo.
The watermark 'POSTED ON JI GEARUP INC.' is present on all photos.

response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
